items.titleZh: 梅赛德斯在巴西大奖赛将穿新赛车服致敬传奇时代
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队将在本周末的圣保罗大奖赛中穿着紫色赛车服，世界冠军安东内利和乔治·拉塞尔将换下他们常用的黑色和蓝绿色赛车服。这一设计在周二于圣保罗的Nubank公园揭晓，这是车队与巴西银行Nubank合作的一部分。

items.originalTitle: Mercedes to race in new suits at Brazil GP in nod to legendary era
detailZh: 梅赛德斯将在巴西大奖赛中穿着新赛车服，向传奇时代致敬。
世界冠军安东内利和乔治·拉塞尔将在整个周末的Interlagos赛事中穿着这款特殊设计的赛车服，这是本赛季车队第二次穿上紫色赛车服。
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯，安德烈亚·安东内利，梅赛德斯。
对于梅赛德斯车队的粉丝来说，这里有最新的银箭消息，包括来自Brackley和Brixworth的F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和赛事分析。
梅赛德斯车队在本周末的圣保罗大奖赛上看起来会有一些不同，世界冠军基米·安东内利和乔治·拉塞尔将换上紫色的赛车服，而不是他们通常的黑色和蓝色赛车服。
这款设计于周二在圣保罗的Nubank公园揭晓，这是帕尔梅拉斯足球俱乐部的主场，作为车队与巴西银行Nubank合作的一部分。两位车手将在整个周末的各节练习与排位中穿着这套赛车服。
“受过去启发，为未来打造。欢迎来到新纪元，”安东内利在Instagram上写道。“这个周末的新形象！”
这套赛车服由梅赛德斯设计，灵感来源于20世纪80年代和90年代，那是纳尔逊·皮克特和埃尔顿·塞纳赢得他们冠军头衔的时期。这次活动的口号是“受黄金时代启发，为新时代打造”。
两种色调都来自银行。深色基调取自其高端卡Ultravioleta，而较浅的紫色代表其最大的客户群。
这个揭晓伴随着一部介绍两位车手的电影，由在Netflix关于三届冠军的系列剧中扮演塞纳的加布里埃尔·莱昂担任旁白。其配乐是Tema da Vitoria，这是当巴西车手在F1中获胜时，TV Globo播放的音乐，与塞纳的职业生涯紧密相连。
这是梅赛德斯在2026年的第二次这样做。在5月的迈阿密大奖赛上，车队使用了三种不同的紫色西装，每种设计都与Nubank的扩张有关，安东内利随后赢得了那场比赛。
梅赛德斯市场运营主管维多利亚·约翰逊表示，对那些西装的反应让车队兴奋地想在圣保罗更进一步。
“与Nu的合作基于寻找大胆而有意义的方式将粉丝更紧密地与我们团队联系在一起。紫色的赛车服是这种雄心的绝佳表达，将Nu的独特身份与我们自己的身份相结合，同时庆祝巴西对一级方程式的无限热情。在今年早些时候在迈阿密的紫色赛车服反应之后，我们很兴奋在圣保罗更进一步地实现这一概念，为赛季中最具激情的周末之一创造一些独特的东西。”
Nubank联合创始人克里斯蒂娜·茹涅拉补充说：“圣保罗大奖赛对巴西人、对Nubank、对梅赛德斯-AMG PETRONAS F1车队车手来说都是一场特别的比赛，因为它发生在该银行成立的城市。”
这些赛车服也将在Nubank House展出，这是一场为该银行客户举办的免费展览，在体育场进行，直到周日。展览还包括一辆W17的复制品和2021年刘易斯·汉密尔顿穿过的赛车服。
Nubank表示，巴西对一级方程式的兴趣正在迅速增长。它使用Ibope数据表示，2026年的前10场比赛在该国吸引了5280万人观看，已经超过了2025年整个赛季的观众人数。”
梅赛德斯车队如果周日一切顺利，将不仅仅因为新形象而庆祝，因为它可以在英特拉戈斯赛道结束车队 constructors’ championship 的争夺。
detailEn: Mercedes to race in new suits at Brazil GP in nod to legendary era
Kimi Antonelli and George Russell will wear the special design all weekend at Interlagos, the second time this season the team has gone purple
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

The Mercedes team will look a little different at this weekend’s Sao Paulo Grand Prix, with world champion Kimi Antonelli and George Russell switching to purple race suits instead of their usual black and turquoise.

The design was revealed on Tuesday at the Nubank Parque in Sao Paulo, the stadium of football club Palmeiras, as part of the team’s partnership with Brazilian bank Nubank. Both drivers will wear the suits in all sessions of the race weekend.
“Inspired by the past. Built for the New. Welcome, to the Nu Era,” Antonelli wrote on Instagram. “New look for this weekend!”

Designed by Mercedes, the suits borrow from those worn in the 1980s and 1990s, the period when Nelson Piquet and Ayrton Senna won their titles. The campaign’s slogan is “Inspired by the Golden Era, Built for the New Era”.
The two shades both come from the bank. The dark base is taken from Ultravioleta, its premium card, and the lighter purple represents its largest customer base.

The reveal came with a film featuring both drivers, narrated by Gabriel Leone, who played Senna in Netflix’s series about the three-time champion. Its soundtrack is the Tema da Vitoria, the music that TV Globo played when Brazilian drivers won in F1, and which is closely tied to Senna’s career.

It is the second time Mercedes has done this in 2026. At the Miami Grand Prix in May, the team used three different purple suits, one for each day of the weekend, with each design carrying coordinates connected to Nubank’s expansion. Antonelli went on to win that race.
Victoria Johnson, Mercedes’ marketing operations chief, said the reaction to those suits made the team excited to take the idea further in Sao Paulo.

“The partnership with Nu is based on finding bold and meaningful ways to bring fans closer to our team. The purple race suits are an excellent expression of that ambition, uniting Nu’s unmistakable identity with our own while celebrating the incredible passion Brazil has for Formula 1. After the reaction to our purple suits in Miami earlier this year, it is exciting to take this concept even further in Sao Paulo and create something unique for one of the most passionate race weekends of the season.”

Nubank co-founder Cristina Junqueira added: “The Sao Paulo Grand Prix is a special round for Brazilians, for Nubank, because it takes place in the city where it was founded, and for the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team drivers.”

The suits will also be on show at the Nubank House, a free exhibition for the bank’s customers running at the stadium until Sunday. It also includes a replica W17 and a suit worn by Lewis Hamilton in 2021.

Nubank says interest in F1 is growing quickly in Brazil. Using Ibope data, it said the first 10 races of 2026 reached 52.8 million people in the country, already more than the whole of the 2025 season.
Mercedes will have more to celebrate than a new look if things go its way on Sunday, as it can wrap up the constructors’ championship at Interlagos.

items.titleZh: 梅基斯：勒克莱尔处罚过轻
items.summaryZh: 法拉利在墨西哥城大奖赛的开局阶段引发了争议，查尔斯·勒克莱尔与刘易斯·汉密尔顿在4号弯的激烈碰撞改变了赛事走向，但国际汽联 stewards 的判决让一些人感到失望。

media.altZh: 梅基斯：勒克莱尔处罚过轻 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Laurent Mekies: Charles Leclerc’s penalty “felt a bit light”
detailZh: 劳伦特·梅基斯：查尔斯·勒克莱尔被罚的“有点轻”
劳伦特·梅基斯认为查尔斯·勒克莱尔在墨西哥城大奖赛第一圈碰撞后被罚五秒有点轻
对于红牛车队的粉丝来说，关注红牛车队，了解F1新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和米尔顿凯恩斯的比赛分析。
法拉利在阿特尔多米罗·赫曼诺斯·罗德里格斯赛道的第一圈争议性发车为他们的对手提供了终极礼物。查尔斯·勒克莱尔和刘易斯·汉密尔顿在4号弯的绝望的 车轮对车轮碰撞从根本上改变了墨西哥城大奖赛的轨迹，但随后的国际汽联 翻译为裁判的决定让一些维修区的人感到非常失望。
观看那辆红色赛车完全脱离赛道，立即引起了车队负责人劳伦特·梅基斯的警觉。这位法国高管密切监控了第一圈的混乱情况，立刻意识到摩纳哥车手离开沥青路面并获得持久优势的行为不可避免地会受到体育处罚。
“你的第一反应就是应该受到处罚，'梅基斯在赛后媒体任务中透露。'作为当时的一名竞争者，这是你首先想到的事情。
最终，赛事控制部门对法拉利明星车手处以五秒时间罚分，但决定的延迟发布严重削弱了其对赛程的影响。因为勒克莱尔已经利用干净空气拉大了与队友的巨大差距，因此时间扣除部分被抵消了。
“我们确实对确认处罚所需的时间感到有些惊讶，'梅基斯承认，并指出国际汽联延迟裁决的明显缺陷。'我们也对只罚五秒感到惊讶，因为在他们给出那个处罚的时候，我认为查尔斯已经比刘易斯领先五秒了。”
查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
车队老板没有掩饰他对监管宽松的挫败感，表示处罚"感觉有点轻"，但承认"这就是它本来的样子"。
与其完全依赖裁判来中和法拉利的威胁，策略小组采取了主动。当勒克莱尔为更换新胎而驶入维修区时，梅基斯和他的车队墙执行了一次完美的掩护策略，同时将自己的赛车驶入维修区，以否认马拉内洛车队获得任何干净的空气下压力优势。
"这又是一次极其出色的执行,"梅基斯赞扬道。"当听到查尔斯要进站时，策略小组和车队墙上的那些人想出了那个策略，考虑到处罚，这是我们对他差距的最佳策略，我们采取了行动，而且它成功了。"
战术大师课的展示，加上冠军车手维斯塔潘的激烈防守，最终将法拉利车队阻挡在外。梅克斯特别强调了维斯塔潘在首节练习中的精湛驾驶，表示他"无疑地做得非常出色，在比赛中将刘易斯和查尔斯保持在身后，直到他们与他并肩作战的那一刻"。
detailEn: Laurent Mekies: Charles Leclerc’s penalty “felt a bit light”
Laurent Mekies beleives Charles Leclerc's five-second Mexico City GP penalty was a bit light after Ferrari's lap one clash
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

Ferrari’s divisive opening lap at the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez provided the ultimate gift to their rivals. Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton's desperate wheel-to-wheel clash at Turn 4 fundamentally altered the trajectory of the Mexico City Grand Prix, but the subsequent ruling from the FIA stewards left some on the pitwall severely underwhelmed.

Watching the scarlet cars run completely off the track immediately triggered alarms for team principal Laurent Mekies. The French executive closely monitored the lap 1 chaos, instantly recognising that a sporting sanction was inevitable for the Monegasque driver leaving the asphalt and gaining a lasting advantage.

"The first thing that comes to your mind is that should be a penalty," Mekies revealed during his post-race media duties. "That's the first thing that come to your mind as a competitor at that moment."

Race control ultimately handed the Ferrari star a five-second time penalty, but the delayed timing of the decision severely blunted its actual impact on the running order. Because Leclerc had already used the clean air to pull a massive gap over his team-mate, the time deduction was partly negated because of this.

"We were certainly a bit surprised by how long it took to see the penalty confirmed," Mekies admitted, noting the glaring flaw in the FIA's delayed ruling. "We were also surprised that it was only five seconds because probably at the time they had given that penalty, I think Charles was already clear five seconds from Lewis anyway."
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari
The team boss did not hold back his frustration with the regulatory leniency, stating the punishment "felt a bit light" but acknowledging "it's what it is".

Rather than relying solely on the stewards to neutralise the Ferrari threat, the strategy group took matters into their own hands. When Leclerc dived into the pits for fresh tyres, Mekies and his pitwall executed a flawless cover strategy, bringing their own car in simultaneously to deny the Maranello squad any clean-air undercut advantage.

"It was once again an extremely strong execution," Mekies praised. "The usual suspects with the strategy group and on the pitwall that came up with that when we heard Charles was coming in, and that was the best we had just about the gap to him considering the penalty, and took the shot, and it worked."

The tactical masterclass, combined with a fierce defensive drive from race winner Max Verstappen, ultimately kept the Ferraris at bay. Mekies specifically highlighted Verstappen's clinical driving during the opening stint, stating he did "undoubtedly a very good job at keeping Lewis and Charles behind for the moment they were racing with him".

items.originalTitle: Lando Norris blasts F1 top speed limiters: “We should easily go quicker than a motorbike”
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯抨击F1速度限制器：“我们应该能比摩托车更快”
兰多·诺里斯抨击墨西哥城大奖赛中的F1限制器，将赛车比作MotoGP摩托车
对于麦凯轮车迷来说，来自沃金克的木瓜新闻，有关车手、赛车、团队策略以及每个周末的每一场比赛的最新消息。
跟随尾流是F1车手的终极进攻武器。但据兰多·诺里斯所说，当前的技术规则已经让尾流变得不那么有用。
被困在墨西哥城大奖赛的赛道上，麦克拉伦车手对F1的赛车表达了不满。他认为，由于电池部署上限造成的假天花板，使得在车辆实力相当的情况下，进行超车变得几乎不可能，无论是进行紧急刹车俯冲还是直线超车。
‘超车的关键在于你有一个限制器，’诺里斯在维修区解释道。‘就像你真的有一个限制器阻止你超过某个速度，所以即使你落后对手两十分之一秒，你只要触碰到这个限制器，和他们的限制器一样，然后你就无法再加速，这有点破坏了比赛的乐趣。’
2026年的规则将重点放在主动空气动力学上，使用低阻力直线模式，在像阿特尔多·赫曼诺斯·罗德里格斯赛道1.2公里长的前直道这样的长直道上最大化速度。但诺里斯坚信，管理机构将赛车束缚在不必要的限制中，直接指向两轮赛车运动世界作为证据。
‘他们需要为下个赛季改进这一点，’这位英国人要求道。‘尤其是当摩托车可以跑到370公里每小时，而你甚至没有安全带或任何东西，而我们本应该能够比摩托车跑得更快，你知道的。’
他补充说，这个人为的限制从根本上破坏了周日赛道上的比赛产品。
一位记者坚持追问，未来的引擎规则调整是否可能自然地解决最高速度的瓶颈。沃金明星迅速否定了这个理论，坚持认为只要存在硬性限制，动力系统修改就完全无关紧要。
“不，我的意思是这与它无关，”他澄清说。、“即使有直线模式，我们仍然能达到同样的最高速度，明年用同样的动力在直线模式和直线模式下你仍然能达到同样的最高速度，所以你只需要提高限制器。就这么简单。”
查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利，兰多·诺里斯，麦克拉伦
尽管他对规则手册进行了激烈的批评，这位26岁的车手拒绝将速度限制作为错过领奖台的完全借口。他意识到，在墨西哥需要巨大的原始速度差距才能完成超车，他将责任明确指向了麦凯轮车队自己的维修区。
“今天没有什么能让我感到失望，”他承认。“只是你需要非常快才能超车。除非你快得多，否则没有人能完成超车。所以，除了我们周六表现不佳之外，没有其他可以责怪的地方。”
detailEn: Lando Norris blasts F1 top speed limiters: “We should easily go quicker than a motorbike”
Lando Norris blasts F1's limiter for ruining racing at the Mexico City GP, comparing the cars to MotoGP bikes
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.

Riding in the slipstream is supposed to be the ultimate offensive weapon for a Formula 1 driver. But according to Lando Norris, the current technical regulations have turned the draft into something a little less useful.

Trapped in a train throughout the Mexico City Grand Prix, the McLaren driver vented his frustrations over F1's car. He argued that the artificial ceiling, created by a cap on battery on battery deployment, makes late-braking divebombs and straight-line passes practically impossible against evenly matched cars.

"I mean the main thing with overtaking is you just have the limiter on," Norris explained in the paddock. "Like you literally have a limiter that stops you from going over a speed, so it doesn't matter if you come out two tenths behind the guy, you just hit the limiter and the same limiter as them, and then you cannot do anything, so it kind of ruins racing."

The 2026 regulations heavily feature active aerodynamics, using a low-drag Straight Mode to maximise velocity on massive stretches of track such as the 1.2-kilometre front straight at the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez. But Norris firmly believes the governing body is keeping the cars on an unnecessary leash, pointing directly to the two-wheeled motorsport world as proof.

"It’s something that they need to improve for next season," the Brit demanded. "Especially when motorbikes go 370, and you don't have a seat belt or anything, and we should easily be able to go quicker than a motorbike, you know."
He added that the artificial cap fundamentally damaged the on-track product on Sunday.

Pressing the issue, a journalist asked if future engine rule tweaks might naturally solve the top speed plateau. The Woking star quickly shut down the theory, insisting that powertrain modifications are completely irrelevant as long as the hard limit exists.

"No, I mean that’s got nothing to do with it," he clarified. "We still achieve the same top speeds when you have Straight Mode, and in Straight Mode and with the same power next year you still achieve the same top speed, so you just need to make the limiter higher. It’s as simple as that."
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lando Norris, McLaren

Despite his intense criticism of the rulebook, the 26-year-old refused to use the speed cap as a total excuse for missing the podium. Recognising that a massive raw pace delta was required to execute a pass in Mexico, he pointed the finger squarely at McLaren's own garage.
"Nothing ruined today," he confessed. "It’s just you have to be very quick to pass. No one could get any overtakes unless you’re a lot quicker. So nothing to blame but our poor Saturday."

items.titleZh: 利亚姆·劳森出色表现令小红牛2027年头疼
items.summaryZh: 利亚姆·劳森在2026赛季表现突出，得分高居中游车手之首，但仍有失去2027年车位的威胁。

media.altZh: 利亚姆·劳森出色表现令小红牛2027年头疼 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Liam Lawson’s remarkable form is giving Red Bull a headache for 2027
detailZh: 利亚姆·劳森的出色表现令小红牛2027年头疼。
利亚姆·劳森在本赛季一直表现稳定，但仍面临尼古拉·索洛夫的竞争，争夺2027年的车位数。
截至2026年，利亚姆·劳森在一级方程式赛车中游车手中表现突出。
劳森至今已获得83分，几乎是排名第二的皮埃尔·加斯利的两倍——这还不包括他在小红牛车队的短暂时间，在那段时间里，他每场比赛的得分与在青训车队时的得分相差无几（4.67比4.31）。
然而，劳森在位于法恩扎的车队中，以及整个F1赛场上失去座位的可能性相当大，这将是2027赛季的事情。
F2冠军争夺者尼古拉·斯托洛夫在2026赛季前14场比赛中赢得了惊人的六场胜利，成为了第二辆小红牛赛车的热门人选，但他的资格赛速度并没有像他的主要竞争对手那样出色，他在过去11场比赛中也没有登上领奖台的顶端。
尽管如此，这位19岁的保加利亚人距离冠军领跑者拉斐尔·卡马拉只有七分之差，而卡马拉本周末将在巴西大奖赛中首次亮相F1，所以他仍然有真正的夺冠机会。
与此同时，随着阿维德·林德布拉德稳健的F1新秀赛季，劳森在法恩扎的时间似乎注定要结束。但到目前为止，他在所有队友中表现都不如他们——久保东佑树、马克斯·维斯塔潘、伊萨克·哈达尔——劳森在林德布拉德身上占据了上风。
在排位赛中，劳森以12-6的成绩领先他们的直接对决，扣除不具有代表性的墨尔本赛程后，这是9-5的成绩和0.027秒的差距，没有冲刺排位赛的话。更有趣的是，他在比赛状态下的平均速度比队友快了0.141秒。
在过去的一个月里，劳森不仅证明了自己具有竞争力，而且还是一个稳健的搭档。在排位赛中，自从他在红牛的三轮比赛中代替伊萨克·哈迪亚尔回到小红牛后，他就没有在排位上输过，平均每圈快了0.257秒。
新西兰人在过去四场大奖赛中共获得了24分——比哈迪亚尔和乔治·拉塞尔都要多。由于在马来西亚受到发车罚分和与奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的碰撞，林德布拉德在这段时间内只得到了1分。
红牛对于2027年的决定可能取决于一个简单的问题：劳森最近的表现是否表明他可能值得再次获得主车队的另一个机会？
如果这样的话，Tsolov可能不得不等待时机——也许是在Super Formula，在那里，许多其他红牛青训车手在从GP2/F2毕业后参加了比赛。这条道路为加斯利和那位非常出色的劳森带来了F1的驾驶机会。
但如果红牛看不到劳森回到米尔顿凯恩斯的现实道路，尽管他的当前表现很难忽视，那么让他留在小红牛可能就没有那么有意义了，Tsolov可能会得到展示自己的机会。
并且随着每一次的积分完成，劳森都会被问到关于他未来的同样问题。在墨西哥赛后媒体区，他又被问及，尽管与Lindblad的差距“巨大”，但他座位的不确定性是否是一种遗憾。
“这显然是非常遗憾的，但这是我现在必须面对的事情，”他回应道。“我显然每次上车都在尽力做我能做的一切。”
让我们看看这够不够。
detailEn: Liam Lawson’s remarkable form is giving Red Bull a headache for 2027
Liam Lawson has been a consistent performer this season, yet he’s still at threat from Nikola Tsolov for a 2027 drive
So far in 2026, Liam Lawson has been a clear standout performer in Formula 1’s midfield.

Lawson has scored 83 points so far, nearly twice as many as second-best Pierre Gasly’s 42 – and that’s not even down to his Red Bull stint, during which he barely scored more points per race than with Racing Bulls (4.67 vs 4.31).
Yet, there’s a substantial chance Lawson loses his seat at the Faenza-based outfit – and on the F1 grid altogether – for the 2027 season.

Formula 2 title contender Nikola Tsolov emerged as a frontrunner for the second Racing Bulls seat as he claimed a whopping six victories across the first 14 races of the 2026 season, but his qualifying pace has not been as good as his main rivals’ and he has failed to reach the top step of the podium in the last 11 contests.

Still, the 19-year-old Bulgarian is just seven points down on championship leader Rafael Camara – who is set to make his F1 debut with Haas this weekend at the Brazil GP – so he still has genuine championship chances.

Meanwhile, with Arvid Lindblad’s solid F1 rookie campaign, Lawson’s time in Faenza seemed destined to end. But after being outperformed by every one of his team-mates thus far – Yuki Tsunoda, Max Verstappen, Isack Hadjar – Lawson has had the upper hand on Lindblad.

In qualifying, Lawson leads their head-to-head 12-6, with a 0.072s advantage discounting the unrepresentative Melbourne session – that’s 9-5 and a 0.027s gap without sprint qualifying. More interestingly, he is 0.141s faster than his team-mate on average in race trim.

And over the last month, Lawson has proven to be a not just competitive but also safe pair of hands. In qualifying, he hasn’t been outqualified on merit, lapping 0.257s faster on average, since he returned to Racing Bulls after his three-round stint at Red Bull, standing in for Isack Hadjar.

The New Zealander has collected 24 points in the last four grands prix – more than Hadjar and George Russell. Hindered by a grid penalty in Malaysia and a collision with Oscar Piastri in Mexico, Lindblad has scored just one in the meantime.
Red Bull’s upcoming decision for 2027 may hinge on one simple question: do Lawson’s recent drives suggest he might ever be deserving of another chance at the main team?

If so, Tsolov may have to bide his time – perhaps in Super Formula, where several other Red Bull juniors competed after graduating from GP2/F2. That avenue led to F1 drives for Pierre Gasly and that very Lawson.

But if Red Bull sees no realistic path back to Milton Keynes for Lawson, however hard to ignore his current performance is, then keeping him at Racing Bulls won’t make as much sense, and Tsolov may get his chance to shine.

And with every points finish, Lawson gets the same question about his future. In Mexico’s post-race media pen, he was again asked if it was a shame that his seat was still a matter of uncertainty despite the ‘huge’ gap to Lindblad.
“It’s obviously a massive shame, but it’s something that I’m just having to deal with at the moment,” he responded. “I’m obviously trying to do everything I can each time I get in the race car.”
Let’s see if that will be enough.
keyPointsZh: 劳森的得分几乎是第二名皮埃尔·加斯利的两倍。
尽管在加入小红牛车队期间，劳森每场比赛的得分与在青训车队时的得分相差无几。
keyPointsEn: Lawson has scored nearly twice as many points as the second-best driver, Pierre Gasly.
During his stint with Red Bull, Lawson's points per race were barely higher than with Racing Bulls (4.67 vs 4.31).
